notes.title: Helms of Fury is an action rogue-lite with a focus on collecting abilities and fast combat
notes.notes:
After a new fast-paced action dungeon crawler? Helms of Fury built with Godot Engine looks like a lot of fun and worth keeping an eye on.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/10/helms-of-fury-is-an-action-rogue-lite-with-a-focus-on-collecting-abilities-and-fast-combat
